msrframe · trainable MSR neutronics design framework

EVOL MSFR - alternative plug-ins

Generated 2026-11-04 04:02. Every stage's methods are plug-ins chosen in the YAML config; all numbers come from the data files listed there.

Overview

476screening runs
61 inputs -> 9 kept
200k_eff runs
best: gp (278 pcm)

Stage 1 - Parameter screening

4 screening methods (random_forest, sobol_pce, sobol_surrogate:dnn, spearman) were applied to 476 runs over 61 inputs. They retain 5, 7, 7, 4 inputs respectively (lowest pairwise Jaccard agreement 0.22). Consensus (2+ votes plus safety-forced inputs) keeps 9 inputs: u238_pct, hn_molpct, uf4_molpct, u234_pct, u236_pct, li7_enrich, core_radius, fuel_inlet_T, fuel_density_mult. A GP on this set reaches 661 pcm CV RMSE (R2 = 0.9936). Lowest retention-curve error: sobol_pce.

Stage 2 - k_eff predictor

Best k_eff surrogate on 200 runs: gp with 278 pcm cross-validated RMSE (R2 = 0.99836, 95% interval coverage 94%). The Monte Carlo noise of the targets is 197 pcm rms, so part of every error is OpenMC noise. Worst: extra_trees (2278 pcm). Learning curves show the error of gp falling from 427 to 262 pcm as training data grow - adding OpenMC runs keeps improving it.
